photo.description: Professor Alexander Fleming at work in his laboratory at St Mary's Hospital, London, during the Second World War. Professor Alexander Fleming at work in his laboratory at St Mary's Hospital, London. Fourteen years after his discovery of penicillin, he is still experimenting to investigate the effect of the drug on bacteria.
